title: Heap Sort
definition: An in-place sorting algorithm that converts the array into a Max-Heap, then repeatedly extracts the maximum element and places it at the end of the array. O(N log N) time and O(1) space.
simpleExplanation: Turning the data into a leaderboard, then popping the #1 player off the top and putting them at the back of the line over and over until everyone is sorted.

answers.question: **Basic:** Identify the core logic required to implement Heap Sort.
**Intermediate 1:** Solve a standard problem using Heap Sort in O(N log N) or O(N) time.
**Intermediate 2:** Adapt Heap Sort to handle strings or distinct objects instead of numbers.
**Advanced:** Use Heap Sort to solve a complex sub-array or sub-string problem (e.g. Longest non-repeating).
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize Heap Sort to achieve strictly O(1) space constraints while maintaining linear time.
